backend/main.mo: Main canister actor defining authorization, pairing, profiles, schedules, filters, logs, and phone-verification types and state initialization.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old stored state to new structures including phone numbers and phone-verification data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping new phone-based pairing and i18n changes to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file and recent behavior changes like polling and i18n updates.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining light and dark theme tokens and global styling variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint configuring metadata, icons, manifest, root div, and script loader for the React app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest providing app metadata, theme settings, orientation, and icons.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing asset caching, fetch handling, and background sync for queued location updates.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling authentication flow, profile setup, role-based routing, and landing page rendering.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccountsTa: Admin table that lists user accounts, shows roles, and allows enabling/disabling accounts with confirmation.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPassw: UI for verifying or changing the admin password before granting access to admin features.
frontend/src/components/admin/Aggregated: Displays dashboard metric cards for counts of users, parents, children, and pairings.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertsPan: Child-facing alerts showing daily usage limit status and allowing over-limit time requests.
Parent-facing alerts summarizing a child's daily usage and whether limits were exceeded.
frontend/src/components/audit/AuditLogTa: Table showing sorted audit log entries for a child, including action type, executor, and timestamp.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Toggle login/logout using Internet Identity, clearing queries and admin gate on logout and handling login errors.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Collects name, role, and optional phone number to save a user profile via mutation.
frontend/src/components/child/ActivityHi: Fetches and displays a child's activity history in a sortable table with optional transparency label.
frontend/src/components/child/ChildCheck: Allows children to submit activity or location check-ins and toggle live location sharing with capability/error handling.
frontend/src/components/child/ConsentNot: Shows a consent notice with icon and text based on activity, location, or pairing type.
frontend/src/components/child/LocationHi: Fetches and displays a child's location history in a sortable table with optional transparency label.
frontend/src/components/child/PairWithPa: Enables pairing with a parent via code or phone/OTP flow with validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/filters/ContentF: Loads and edits a child's content filter configuration, allowing category toggles and allowlist/blocklist changes.
Displays a read-only view of a child's content filter, showing categories and allow/block lists fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSel: Provides a dropdown menu to switch app language using the i18n hook.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Renders the app footer with links, branding, and a button to view transparency policies.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Displays the app header with branding, user info, theme toggle, language selector, and transparency link.
frontend/src/components/parent/ActivityV: Shows a consent reminder and a list of a child's activity history with periodic refresh.
frontend/src/components/parent/ChildSumm: Card summarizing a child's recent activities and shared locations, highlighting selection state.
frontend/src/components/parent/LiveLocat: Fetches and displays the child's latest location, live sharing status, and time-ago info with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/parent/LocationV: Tabbed view showing live map and historical location data with a consent reminder.
frontend/src/components/parent/PairingSe: Generates and displays a pairing code for linking accounts, with warnings and copy-to-clipboard support.
frontend/src/components/parent/ParentPho: Lets parents view and edit their phone number with validation and profile-saving logic.
frontend/src/components/schedule/Schedul: Provides a UI to edit a child's daily screen limit and allowed time windows, saving updates via mutations.
Displays a child's schedule and screen time limits in a read-only format.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGate.ts: Tracks a simple session-based admin gate flag with functions to set or clear it.
frontend/src/hooks/useI18n.ts: Returns the current i18n context for translations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login/clear actions, and initializes AuthClient with stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveLocationSharin: Periodically captures geolocation, submits updates with retry queuing, and tracks sharing status and errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for interacting with backend actor methods, including profile, admin checks, relationships, activities, and locations.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: Implements an i18n context provider with language persistence, translation lookup, and parameter replacement.
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Exports supported locales and translation dictionaries, wiring English and Portuguese translations.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/en.ts: Defines the English translation strings for UI text across the app.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/pt-BR.ts: Defines the Brazilian Portuguese translation strings for all app UI text.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind CSS and defines light/dark theme variables for a navy‑themed design system.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel showing user accounts, parent‑child links, and aggregated metrics with tabbed navigation.
frontend/src/pages/child/ChildHome.tsx: Child home page displaying check‑ins, history, schedule, filters, alerts, and optional parent‑pairing card.
frontend/src/pages/parent/ParentDashboar: Parent dashboard providing child management, pairing setup, and detailed tabs for each selected child.
Renders a modal page showing transparency and policy details using translated text and UI components.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Registers the service worker and exposes helpers for background and periodic sync support.
frontend/src/utils/liveLocationCapabilit: Detects device and PWA capabilities for geolocation and background updates and returns a user message.
frontend/src/utils/locationUpdateQueue.t: LocalStorage‑backed queue handling retries and storage for offline location update submissions.
frontend/src/utils/phoneNumber.ts: Utility functions for normalizing, validating, formatting, and parsing 11‑digit phone numbers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters across navigation and session storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config enabling class-based dark mode, custom OKLCH color system, extended fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing requirements and issues for fixing 6‑digit OTP pairing and adding phone/SMS-based parent‑child linking.
